content_zh:
【叮咚~系统提示：“叫我奈落大人”被禁言一周，请大家遵守论坛正常秩序，谢谢！
小贴士：成为论坛高级会员，可以减免禁言时间哦！】
作为权限汪……阿不，是作为“高贵的管理员”的关立远，这时正准备实验一下技能，并不知道被强卖了改名卡的奈落，这时又再次被禁言了。
只见在关立远的指尖前，凭空浮现出一副巴掌大的魔法阵，一道白色的光影从魔法阵中刺出，迎向了大汉伸向自己的手掌……
瞬间一道血色从大汉的手掌处绽放出来！
眼尖的人已经看出，那“白光”是一根晶莹如玉、如小拇指长短粗细，前端尖利的锥子！
毫不费力的刺穿了大汉的手掌之后，甚至还在对方的惨叫声中，钉在了对方的胳膊上、没入大半……
“这、这就是职业者？”
“是元素使吗？这是什么元素的能力？”
“这人疯了吧？居然当街袭击职业者？”
“没错，虽然联盟会约束职业者，不得伤害平民，但是如果有人自己找死……”
“嘘！小声点，那家伙是贡氏家族的人！”
街上原本围观的人，不由得议论纷纷了起来。
而这边的骚乱，马上也引起了维持秩序的城卫的注意。
不过因为距离议员、家主们的队伍不远，马上钟离犼、贡连等人，就先一步赶过来了！
看到城中的各方大佬们在场，城卫们也只是围在一旁而不靠近。
“田贡好！你好大的胆子，居然敢当街袭击刚刚觉醒成功的职业者，说！是谁指使你的，是不是被深渊魔物策反了！”钟离犼震声道。
“职、职业者？他……怎么可能……我、我是……家主、我不知道啊……”田贡好语无伦次起来。
即便在跪下之后，依旧双目无神，似乎还没有反应过来，为什么四个月前，自己从街上随便绑来、没上过什么学的小乞丐，会转身成为职业者？
他本能的跪下求救的目标，自然不是钟离犼，而是贡氏的家主贡连！

“田方，我之前就听说你多次打着贡家的名义为非作歹，只是一直没有证据……这次你没什么可说的了吧？城卫们还愣着做什么，还不将这几个胆大妄为的家伙拿下。”贡连翻脸无情，而且也就开始用田贡好之前的原名称呼他。
“等等！不是这样的！我、我只是想抓一个小乞丐……他还、还打过贡文少爷，他才是犯人……听我解释！”
城卫长随手甩了他一耳光，并且对脸颊缓缓肿起的田贡好冷声说道：“什么乱七八糟的！虽然没听懂，但是没让你开口之前，再敢开口……哼！”
城卫长会这么做，显然也是看出了面前几人的脸色，钟离犼且不说，田贡好的后台贡连，此时都冷眼看着他，而贡连身后的贡文眼神就更加怨毒了……
谁叫田贡好哪壶不开提哪壶呢？生怕别人不知道，贡文被关立远揍过吗？
所以城卫长抽他嘴巴是全无顾虑……
田贡好手下的几名打手，自然也没有能幸免的，就算是手掌被扎了个窟窿，也享受不到什么伤员待遇，被城卫们纷纷拿下。
见到这一幕，果然大佬们并无表示，仿佛眼不见、心不烦，即便是关立远此时也没有“大仇得报”之类的特殊反应，反而愣在原地，似乎还在回味着自己刚刚第一次触发技能的感觉！
至于贡家的几条狗被捕，并不能令关立远太兴奋！
之后田贡好究竟是什么结果，也根本不需要关注，贡家不愿意搭理他，钟离家族又想用他给贡家泼一泼脏水，自然将他往常的所作所为，挖了个干净……
贡家对羽翼下出现这样的害群之马深感痛惜，并表示一定会大义灭亲……
“原来这就是职业者的‘技能’……好神奇，只要在脑海中，本能的激发对应符文，就可以造成这样的效果！”
直到和钟离秋、魏樱樱一起来到钟离家的大宅，关立远还在感叹着技能的神奇。
钟离秋对于关立远这种“土包子”的行径，不由得只撇嘴：“‘本能’的激发符文？立远，不是我打击你……就你刚才的技能释放速度，估计对方再有根棒子，就能直接打断你释放的技能！”
“咳咳，我这不是第一次嘛！”关立远有些不好意思的说道。
这章没有结束^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢次元论坛请大家
content_en:
[Ding Dong~ The system prompts: "Call me Naraku-sama" has been banned for a week. Please abide by the normal order of the forum. Thank you!
Tips: Become a senior member of the forum and you can reduce the ban time! 】
As someone with authority... no, it was Guan Liyuan as the "noble administrator". He was about to experiment with his skills at this time, but he didn't know that Naraku, who had been forcibly sold the name-changing card, was banned again.
In front of Guan Liyuan's fingertips, a palm-sized magic array appeared out of thin air. A white light and shadow pierced out from the magic array and faced the palm that the big man stretched out to him...
Instantly, a streak of blood bloomed from the big man's palm!
People with sharp eyes have already seen that the "white light" is a crystal-like jade, as long and thick as a little finger, with a sharp awl at the front!
After piercing the big man's palm effortlessly, he even nailed the opponent's arm and penetrated most of it while the opponent screamed...
"This, this is a professional?"
"Is it an elementalist? What elemental ability is this?"
"Is this person crazy? He actually attacks professionals on the street?"
"That's right, although the alliance will restrict professionals from harming civilians, if someone is seeking death..."
"Shh! Keep your voice down, that guy is from the Gong family!"
The people who were watching on the street couldn't help but start talking.
The commotion here immediately attracted the attention of the city guards who maintained order.
However, because it was not far from the team of councilors and family heads, Zhonglihuan, Gonglian and others rushed over immediately!
Seeing the presence of all the big guys in the city, the city guards just stood around and didn't get close.
"Hello Tian Gong! You are so brave. You actually dare to attack a professional who has just successfully awakened in the street. Tell me! Who instigated you? Were you instigated by the abyss monsters to rebel?" Zhong Lixuan said in a shocked voice.
"O-professional? How could he...I-I am...the head of the family, I don't know..." Tian Gong started to speak incoherently.
Even after kneeling down, his eyes were still blank, and he seemed to have not yet realized why the little beggar he kidnapped from the street without any education four months ago turned around and became a professional?
The target he instinctively knelt down to ask for help was naturally not Zhongli Jian, but Gong Lian, the head of the Gong family!
"Tian Fang, I have heard before that you have done evil in the name of the Gong family many times, but there has been no evidence... You have nothing to say this time, right? What are the city guards doing in a daze, instead of taking down these daring guys." Gong Lian turned his back and began to call Tian Gonghao by his original name.
"Wait! That's not it! I, I just want to catch a little beggar... He also beat Master Gongwen. He is the criminal... Listen to my explanation!"
The city guard chief slapped him casually, and said coldly to Tian Gonghao, whose cheeks were slowly swelling: "What nonsense! Although I don't understand, but before I let you speak, do you dare to speak again... Huh!"
The Chief of City Guards would do this because he obviously saw the faces of the people in front of him. Not to mention Zhong Lihuan, Gong Lian, who was good at Tian Gong's backstage, was looking at him coldly at this time, and Gong Wen's eyes behind Gong Lian were even more resentful...
Who calls Tian Gong good? Which pot should he not open and lift? I'm afraid that others don't know, has Gongwen been beaten by Guan Liyuan?
So the city guard chief had no worries about slapping him in the mouth...
Naturally, the few thugs under Tian Gonghao were not spared. Even if their palms were punctured, they were not treated as wounded soldiers and were taken down by the city guards one after another.
Seeing this scene, the bosses didn't express anything, as if they were out of sight and out of mind. Even Guan Liyuan didn't have any special reaction at this time, such as "revenge". Instead, he froze in place, as if he was still reminiscing about the feeling of triggering the skill for the first time!
As for the arrest of several dogs of the Gong family, Guan Liyuan was not too excited!
afterThere is no need to pay attention to Tian Gonghao's results. The Gong family is unwilling to pay attention to him, and the Zhongli family wants to use him to throw dirty water on the Gong family. Naturally, they will dig up everything he usually does...
The Gong family deeply deplored the appearance of such a black sheep under their wings, and stated that they would definitely exterminate their relatives with justice...
"It turns out that this is the 'skill' of professionals... It's so magical. Just by instinctively stimulating the corresponding runes in your mind, you can create such an effect!"
Guan Liyuan was still sighing at the magic of his skills until he arrived at Zhongli's mansion with Zhong Liqiu and Wei Yingying.
Zhong Liqiu couldn't help but curl his lips at Guan Liyuan's "bumpkin" behavior: "'Instinct' stimulating rune? Liyuan, I'm not the one to hit you... With the speed of your skill release just now, I guess the opponent can directly interrupt the skill you release if he has a stick!"
"Ahem, this isn't my first time!" Guan Liyuan said with some embarrassment.
